tagline: Global flooring solutions company offering integrated portfolio of carpet tile, LVT, rubber flooring and premium area rugs
hero_kpi_rationale: Consolidated net sales is the primary indicator of the company's overall performance in the flooring sector, reflecting market demand and the company's ability to sell its integrated product portfolio.

kpis.name: Consolidated Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total sales of the company's flooring products.
kpis.description: Consolidated net sales increased 5.4% in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to an increase in sales volume and average selling prices.
kpis.signal: Solid sales growth, driven by demand in the healthcare and education segments.

kpis.name: Gross Profit Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of net sales remaining after deduction of cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross profit margin improved to 38.7% in 2025 from 36.7% in 2024, supported by higher average selling prices, favorable product mix, and manufacturing efficiencies.
kpis.signal: Gross margin improvement driven by higher selling prices and favorable product mix.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated by the company's core business activities before interest and taxes.
kpis.description: Operating income increased 22.0% in 2025, primarily due to higher sales and improved gross margin.
kpis.signal: Strong operating income growth, reflecting higher sales and gross margin improvement.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Final profit of the company after all expenses, including taxes and interest.
kpis.description: Net income increased 33.6% in 2025, rising from $86.9 million in 2024 to $116.1 million.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in net income, demonstrating improved overall profitability.

kpis.name: Americas Segment Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by operations in the Americas regions (United States, Canada, Latin America).
kpis.description: Americas segment sales totaled $845.6 million in 2025, representing 61% of total sales, up 3.5% compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Moderate growth in the Americas, indicating stable demand in these key markets.

kpis.name: EAAA Segment Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by operations in Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia.
kpis.description: EAAA segment sales totaled $541.3 million in 2025, representing 39% of total sales, up 11.8% compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Robust growth in the EAAA region, driven by strengthened demand in international markets.

kpis.name: Operating Income Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of net sales remaining after deduction of operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating income margin improved to 11.8% in 2025 from 10.2% in 2024, benefiting from higher sales and improved gross margin.
kpis.signal: Operating margin improvement, indicating better operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Net Income Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of net sales remaining after all expenses, representing final profitability.
kpis.description: Net income margin improved to 8.4% in 2025 from 6.6% in 2024, driven by higher operating income and a lower income tax expense as a percentage of sales.
kpis.signal: Increase in net margin, reflecting higher profitability per dollar of sales.

kpis.name: Insurance Proceeds from Cyber Event
kpis.explanation: Amount recovered by the company through insurance following a cyber attack discovered in November 2022.
kpis.description: In 2024, the company recovered $5.6 million in insurance proceeds, comprising $4.8 million of business interruption proceeds and $0.8 million in reimbursement of related costs associated with the November 2022 cyber event.
kpis.signal: Significant recovery of costs related to the cyber event through insurance, closing the claim.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market with several competitors possessing superior financial resources. This can result in pricing pressures, loss of market share, and require additional investments in R&D, manufacturing facilities, and marketing.

risks.title: Loss of Key Personnel
risks.score_rationale: Loss of key personnel, particularly executives and designers, could affect operations. However, this risk appears moderate in the current context with implementation of the One Interface strategy.

risks.title: Changes in Trade Policies and Tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Changes in trade policies, particularly tariffs and trade barriers, have documented material impact. In 2025, the company recorded approximately $7.3 million in additional tariff costs on imported luxury rubber and vinyl products. These costs are expected to continue in 2026.

ai_positioning.summary: Tile has not mentioned artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F filings. Accordingly, its AI positioning cannot be determined from this information.
